method: Passive CDC read, no sampling or control commands; user confirmed IMU enabled on status page and device resting
sampling_note: Existing logs publish one gyro sample about every 2 seconds, not the full-rate stream. They prove rejection by the old absolute 160-count admission bound, not full-rate variance or calibration success.
fix: Empirical 800-count bias admission, 2-second/80-sample fresh gravity-supported stable window, 320-count range. No uncalibrated zero-bias fallback.
limitation: Constant slow yaw can resemble stationary bias; the user must rest the device during calibration. Thresholds are not manufacturer specifications or proof of perfect hardware behavior.
